names.note: Name page 9272 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Алексий (Воробьев), протоиерей, сщмч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line giving only the bare genitive «Алексия» inside a company of eight. `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE; `gregory-vorobyov` carries the same surname and a different forename.

death.note: The company's line closes «(1937)», which is the whole of what the source gives for him; no year of birth anywhere, and no life page behind his name.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 7 августа ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Александра, Петра, Михаила, Иоанна, Димитрия и Алексия пресвитеров, Елисея диакона и прмч. Афанасия (1937).»

attestations.note: Sixth and last of the six presbyters the day's fourteenth entry enumerates. His name carries an icon link and NO life link, so THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS. The line's «пресвитеров» and name page 9272's «протоиерей» give `presbyter` and the office `Archpriest`. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar's twentieth-century «сщмч.» entries. `ls -d saints/*vorobyov*` returned `gregory-vorobyov` alone, a different forename. The day page prints no hymn under his name.
